lead: Two to twelve steps at two, three or four across. The numbers come from a CSS counter, so reordering the rows in the backend renumbers them — nobody has to keep a sequence correct by hand.

steps.title: Each step has a heading
steps.text: A level-three heading, so a reader navigating by heading can jump into the middle of a procedure.

steps.title: And a sentence or two of what to do
steps.text: Long enough to be an instruction, short enough that the whole procedure still fits on one screen.

steps.title: The link is optional
steps.text: When a step continues on a page of its own, it can carry a link to it.

steps.title: Below 768px the columns collapse
steps.text: One column, and the numbers keep counting across the change.
